choose.when:
/* RealMapper.selectTotal 전체 현황 - 현재 시간 기준 */
SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', '') AS IN_TIME, SUM(SEND_CNT) AS SEND_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -#{totalMonTime}, GETDATE())
choose.otherwise:
/* RealMapper.selectTotal 전체 현황 - 최근 발송 시간 기준 */
DECLARE @d_date DATETIME SELECT @d_date = (SELECT TOP 1 IN_TIME FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC GROUP BY IN_TIME ORDER BY IN_TIME DESC) SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), MAX(IN_TIME), 8), 4, 8), ':', '') AS IN_TIME, SUM(SEND_CNT) AS SEND_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= DATEADD(N, 0, @d_date) AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -#{totalMonTime}, @d_date)

choose.when:
/* RealMapper.selectRealHistList 옥션 전체 테이블 현황 */
SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', '') IN_TIME , SUM(SEND_CNT) SEND_CNT , SUM(SUCC_CNT) SUCC_CNT , SUM(FAIL_CNT) FAIL_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -1, GETDATE()) AND TABLE_CODE IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 21, 22, 71, 72, 73)
choose.otherwise:
/* RealMapper.selectRealHistList 지마켓 전체 테이블 현황 */
SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', '') IN_TIME , SUM(SEND_CNT) SEND_CNT , SUM(SUCC_CNT) SUCC_CNT , SUM(FAIL_CNT) FAIL_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -1, GETDATE()) AND TABLE_CODE IN (11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19, 20, 23, 24, 30, 31, 32)

mapper.select: /* RealMapper.selectRealHistTableList 테이블별 현황 */ SELECT TOP 1 REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), IN_TIME ,8), 4, 8), ':', '') IN_TIME , SUM(SEND_CNT) SEND_CNT , SUM(SUCC_CNT) SUCC_CNT , SUM(FAIL_CNT) FAIL_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME IN ( SELECT TOP 1 IN_TIME FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} GROUP BY IN_TIME ORDER BY IN_TIME DESC ) AND TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} GROUP BY IN_TIME ORDER BY IN_TIME DESC
